name: input-router
description: Routes oversized Read and MCP connector outputs (over ~2,000 tokens) through Haiku, which returns only the relevant excerpts plus a summary.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn input-router on or off; off unloads its hooks until turned back on.

threshold_tokens.title: Threshold (tokens)
threshold_tokens.description: Outputs estimated above this many tokens are condensed by Haiku.

model.title: Condensing model
model.description: Model alias or id used to extract excerpts.
